items.name: Twist of salt
items.description: Grey salt in a paper twist. Thrown at a Weave-Eater it goes white and still for a few heartbeats; at anything else it only stings.
items.canonStatus: CANON: salt against the Weave-Eaters (book1 ch.20:199-203); the twist GAME-ONLY

items.name: Bone harpoon
items.description: A barbed head of old bone on a length of amber rope. Thrown into a spirit, it pins it where it is.
items.canonStatus: CANON: bone harpoons on amber rope (book1 ch.20:177-191); this one GAME-ONLY
